verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents its own crawl capability: it crawls linked pages, returns up to 500 pages synchronously, and runs background batch crawls of up to 25,000 pages. The evidence does not describe a breadth-first traversal strategy, and it states the page counts as service ceilings rather than as a user-configurable maximum page parameter. Missing for 10: documented breadth-first (or selectable) crawl strategy, an explicit user-configurable max-pages parameter, depth controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit

citations.quote: Crawl a small website section and return page Markdown in one response, with a maximum of 500 pages.
Crawl up to 25,000 pages in a background batch, track progress, and retrieve Markdown or HTML when the job finishes.
Scrape 25K URLs or crawl large websites asynchronously.
